Hero.lead: I build movement programmes, shaped around you and not around pre-set templates. From the initial assessment to the technical work, I'll be by your side at every step.
Hero.credTitle: BSc in Sport and Exercise Science, bio-health track

About.intro: I'm Alessia Alfano, kinesiologist, BSc in Sport and Exercise Science, bio-health track.
About.scope: I work with people who put their health first: chronic back pain, pregnancy and post-partum, recovery after an injury, toning, strength built with judgement. No templates, no shortcuts.
About.method: The first session is always an assessment: posture, mobility, movement habits. The programme is built from there and updated as we work together.
About.credPhotoAlt: Alessia on her graduation day in Sport and Exercise Science

Process.heading:
Four phases.
I'm in all four.
Process.lead: I don't hand you a plan and wave goodbye. The programme is something we do together and every phase is built around you.
